name: RoboTwin 2.0
focus: Scalable synthetic data generation and benchmarking for bimanual robotic manipulation.
simulator_or_platform: RoboTwin platform, dual-arm manipulation; project page emphasizes bimanual setups and generated digital twins.
task_structure: Bimanual manipulation tasks.
Task programs can be synthesized with a multimodal language model agent.
Designed around object diversity and domain randomization.
scene_structure: Object-centric generated scenes.
Dual-arm robot configurations.
Uses object dataset and randomization to create diverse episodes.
useful_for_scene_lab: Reference for AI-generated task programs.
Reference for object dataset + randomized scene instantiation.
Good template for bimanual static checks: both hands visible, object reachable by both arms, task-relevant spatial relations valid.

name: LIBERO
focus: Lifelong robot learning and knowledge transfer in language-conditioned manipulation.
task_structure: Language-conditioned tasks grouped by distribution shift type.
Spatial suite varies spatial arrangements.
Object suite varies object identities.
Goal suite varies goals.
LIBERO-100 mixes entangled object, spatial, and goal transfer.
scene_structure: Procedurally generated tabletop scenes.
Objects, placements, and goals are controlled to isolate knowledge transfer factors.
Human teleoperated demonstrations are provided.
useful_for_scene_lab: Reference task schema should separate object, spatial, and goal variation.
Rejected scenes should record which transfer axis failed: object, spatial, goal, or mixed.
Good model for task suites and curriculum/lifelong ordering.

name: RoboCasa / RoboCasa365
focus: Large-scale household/kitchen manipulation with realistic scenes, assets, and long-horizon tasks.
simulator_or_platform: RoboCasa, built for kitchen environments and household manipulation.
task_structure: Atomic skills include pick/place, opening/closing doors and drawers, twisting knobs, turning levers, pressing buttons, insertion, navigation, sliding racks, and opening/closing lids.
Composite household tasks combine atomic skills.
scene_structure: Kitchen-focused layouts.
Interactable furniture, appliances, and many object categories.
Generative tools can enrich textures/assets.
useful_for_scene_lab: Reference for skill taxonomy and compositional scene generation.
Static checks should verify articulated affordances: handles, knobs, doors, drawers, button reachability.
Good source of household task templates.

name: ManiSkill
focus: Generalizable manipulation skill benchmarking over diverse objects and tasks.

scale.note: Multiple task suites and contributed external benchmark tasks.

task_structure: Manipulation skills with object variation.
Supports external benchmark/task integrations.
scene_structure: Physics-rich scenes built for fast simulation and visual observations.
Community tasks are organized as task cards and environment definitions.
useful_for_scene_lab: Reference for task cards: every generated task should have a compact task card with visuals, success, action/obs, and assets.
Good reference for validator coverage and reproducibility metadata.

name: Meta-World
focus: Multi-task and meta-RL for continuous-control tabletop manipulation.
task_structure: 50 manipulation tasks with shared structure.
Typical primitives include reach, push, pick-place, door/drawer/window operations, buttons, peg insertion, hammering, and assembly.
Evaluation protocols group tasks for meta-learning and multi-task learning.
scene_structure: Compact tabletop environments.
Low-dimensional object and goal state structure.
Parametric variation around object poses and goals.
useful_for_scene_lab: Reference for small, clean task primitives.
Good seed library for AI-generated DexJoCo task families.

name: RLBench
focus: Vision-guided manipulation, few-shot learning, imitation learning, and task creation tooling.
task_structure: 100 unique hand-designed tasks.
Ranges from reaching and door opening to multi-stage tasks such as opening an oven and placing a tray inside.
Each task can provide motion-planner demonstrations via waypoints.
scene_structure: Task-specific scenes with visual observations.
RGB, depth, segmentation, proprioception, over-the-shoulder cameras, and wrist cameras.
useful_for_scene_lab: Reference for task authoring workflow: create task, validate, generate demonstrations.
Static checks should include camera coverage and waypoint/demo feasibility.

name: CALVIN
focus: Long-horizon language-conditioned policy learning from vision and language.

scale.note: Language-conditioned long-horizon tasks across multiple manipulation environments.

task_structure: Tasks are specified by natural language.
Focuses on composing actions over long horizons.
Often evaluated by chaining multiple language instructions.
scene_structure: Tabletop manipulation environments with reusable objects and fixtures.
Data comes from play-style teleoperation with language labels.
useful_for_scene_lab: Reference for language-first task review.
Static checks should include whether visual scene supports the language instruction unambiguously.

name: BEHAVIOR-1K
focus: Human-centered embodied AI with long-horizon everyday household activities.
task_structure: Everyday household activities grounded in human needs.
Long-horizon tasks with complex state changes such as cleaning, cooking, organizing, deformables, and liquids.
scene_structure: Realistic houses, gardens, restaurants, offices, and other human environments.
Objects have physical and semantic properties.
Supports rigid bodies, deformables, and liquids.
useful_for_scene_lab: Reference for scaling beyond tabletop manipulation.
Static review should eventually track semantic state predicates, not just geometry.

name: DexJoCo
task_structure: Tool use, bimanual coordination, long-horizon execution, and reasoning tasks.
Tasks include water plant, hammer nail, fold glasses, pinch tongs, pick bucket, click mouse, bimanual assembly, hanoi, microwave, photograph, and iPad unlock.
scene_structure: MJCF XML scenes.
Reusable robot, object, camera, and table assets.
Raw teleoperation demos and replay/randomization tooling.
useful_for_scene_lab: Current integration target.
Generated scenes can be reviewed through CONFIG_MAPPING-compatible envs.
